name: @octocodeai/claude-plugin
description: Octocode code research tools and public skills for Claude Code
author: Guy Bary <bgauryy@octocodeai.com>

scripts.lint: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json src scripts tests README.md ARCHITECTURE.md && yarn run -T oxlint -c ../../.oxlintrc.json --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives .
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json src scripts tests README.md ARCHITECTURE.md
scripts.verify: yarn build && yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
scripts.prepack: yarn build && yarn typecheck && yarn test
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate ../../.claude-plugin/marketplace.json --strict
